title: Otter Creek FSR 0564.03 (September 19, 2026)
source_text: Otter Creek FSR 0564.03 (September 19, 2026): Planned railway crossing work by CN Rail at 0.3km September 19, 2026. Work will commence at1800hrs. No access during the work. Scottie Creek FSR 5451.01 (September 1 - September 25, 2026) Road repair is planned for Scottie Creek FSR from September 1 to September 25, 2026 at 4km to 5km. There will be no access through the worksite between 7am and 6pm. No detour available.
